title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability bottling : the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. We introduce BOTTLED, a benchmark in which agents receive an entire unlabelled workload and must complete it under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. Agents choose their own approach, such as training a small model or writing a reusable program. Across ten models and three tasks, we find that strong zero-shot task performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models with similar zero-shot scores can differ substantially after bottling, and 48 of 60 bottling runs score below the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of their model’s zero-shot performance. Moreover, 31 of 60 runs underperform the stronger of two small-model distillation baselines with the same token budget. Nevertheless, bottling can yield substantial savings: on query-product relevance classification, Opus 5 retains about 82% of its zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. Bottling is also competitive with Jev, a “system one” model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5 on the same task recovers about 94% of Jev’s macro-F1 at a quarter of Jev’s projected full-workload cost. BOTTLED provides a basis for evaluating and improving agents’ ability to invest limited resources in reusable solutions for large, repetitive workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够解决许多特定任务，但针对数百万个相关实例单独进行查询可能会产生高昂到无法承受的成本。LLM 智能体能否自主为这类工作负载创建更经济的解决方案？我们将这种能力称为“瓶化”（bottling）：即将通用能力转化为兼顾答案质量与摊销成本的特定任务解决方案的能力。我们提出了 BOTTLED 基准测试，其中智能体接收整个未标注的工作负载，并必须在固定的时间、计算资源和 LLM API 预算内完成该任务。智能体可自行选择方法，例如训练一个小模型或编写可重用的程序。在十种模型和三项任务中，我们发现强大的零样本任务表现并不一定能转化为强大的瓶化能力。零样本得分相近的模型在瓶化后可能存在显著差异，且 60 次瓶化运行中有 48 次的得分低于其模型零样本表现 95% 置信区间的下限。此外，在 60 次运行中，有 31 次的表现甚至不如两个小模型蒸馏基线方法中的较强者在相同令牌预算下的表现。尽管如此，瓶化仍能带来显著的成本节约：在查询-产品相关性分类任务上，Opus 5 在报告成本降低约 657 倍的同时，仍保留了其零样本宏 F1 值的约 82%。瓶化方法在与专为低成本、重复性推理而建的“系统一”模型 Jev 的竞争中同样具有竞争力：在相同任务上，Opus 5 以 Jev 预计全工作负载成本的 1/4，恢复了 Jev 宏 F1 值的约 94%。BOTTLED 为评估和改进智能体将有限资源投入大型、重复性工作负载的可重用解决方案的能力提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents are increasingly used to automate narrow, repetitive tasks. Examples include extracting device specifications from millions of product descriptions and converting financial reports into structured records. When an agent invokes a general-purpose LLM for every instance, the total inference cost grows approximately linearly with the number of instances. Yet each task may require only a narrow subset of the model’s capabilities. Recent work argues that small language models are sufficient for many such tasks ( Belcak et al., 2025 ) . Existing approaches train smaller task-specific models through distillation ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) , or create other lightweight artifacts such as reusable programs ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体正被越来越多地用于自动化处理特定领域内的重复性任务。例如，从数百万条产品描述中提取设备规格，或将财务报告转换为结构化记录。当智能体为每个实例调用通用 LLM 时，总推理成本会随实例数量大致线性增长。然而，每项任务可能仅需模型能力的有限子集。近期研究指出，许多此类任务使用小型语言模型便已足够（Belcak 等，2025）。现有方法通过蒸馏训练更小的特定任务模型（Hsieh 等，2023），或创建其他轻量级产物，例如可重用的程序（Wang 等，2025a；Huang 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: The next goal is for LLM agents to create suitable artifacts autonomously for a given repetitive workload. We call this ability bottling : the ability to turn general capabilities into a task-specific solution that balances answer quality and amortised cost. In this work, we evaluate bottling through the quality achieved on a complete batch under fixed resource budgets. The agent must balance exploration and exploitation: resources spent on the creation and refinement of an artifact must be weighed against those needed to apply it across the workload. This requires the agent to judge whether an upfront investment will yield sufficient savings across the batch.
paragraphs.zh: 下一个目标是让 LLM 智能体能够针对给定的重复性工作负载，自主创建合适的产物。我们将这种能力称为“瓶化”：即将通用能力转化为特定任务的解决方案，并在答案质量与摊销成本之间取得平衡。在这项工作中，我们通过固定资源预算下完整批次所达到的质量来评估“瓶化”能力。智能体必须在探索与利用之间取得平衡：用于创建和精炼产物的资源，必须与在整体工作负载中应用该产物所需的资源进行权衡。这要求智能体判断前期的投入是否能在整个批次中带来足够的成本节约。

paragraphs.en: Bottling has direct practical value. An artifact can replace repeated, expensive LLM calls with cheaper operations. Bottling brings the construction of small language models and other task-specific artifacts into the agent’s workflow. This could reduce the human engineering needed to adapt a system to a new repetitive task. For example, on ESCI, Opus 5 achieved a mean bottled macro-F1 of 0.499 at a reported cost of $26.28, compared with a zero-shot macro-F1 of 0.609 and an estimated full-workload cost of $17,273. This retains approximately 82% of the zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. We also consider the newly released Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) , a system one model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5’s mean bottled macro-F1 is approximately 94% of Jev’s 0.531, at roughly a quarter of Jev’s estimated full-workload cost of $105.
paragraphs.zh: “装瓶”具有直接的实际价值。一种人工制品可以用更廉价的操作来替代重复且昂贵的 LLM 调用。“装瓶”将小型语言模型和其他特定任务的人工制品构建过程纳入智能体的工作流程中。这可以减少为适应新的重复性任务而对系统进行人类工程改造所需的工作量。例如，在 ESCI 上，Opus 5 实现的“装瓶”后宏观 F1 均值为 0.499，报告成本为 26.28 美元；相比之下，其零样本宏观 F1 为 0.609，预估完整工作负载成本为 17,273 美元。这意味着在报告成本仅为其约 657 倍的情况下，仍保留了零样本宏观 F1 的约 82%。我们还考虑了新发布的 Jev（Almeida, 2026），这是一个专为廉价、重复性推理而构建的单模型系统：Opus 5 的“装瓶”后宏观 F1 均值约为 Jev 的 0.531 的 94%，而成本仅为 Jev 预估完整工作负载成本（105 美元）的大约四分之一。

paragraphs.en: Beyond its practical value, bottling tests an aspect of intelligence: the ability to reuse computation across related problems. Evidence from human probabilistic reasoning suggests that people reuse previous inferences when answering related queries ( Gershman and Goodman, 2014 ) . We therefore ask whether LLM agents can similarly recognise and exploit opportunities to amortise effort on unfamiliar workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 除了其实际价值之外，装瓶测试还检验了智能体的一个方面：在相关问题中重复利用计算的能力。人类概率推理的证据表明，人们在回答相关查询时会重复利用先前的推论（Gershman 和 Goodman，2014）。因此，我们想知道 LLM 智能体是否也能以类似的方式识别并利用机会，将努力分摊到不熟悉的工作负载上。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Bottled , a benchmark for the bottling capabilities of LLM agents. Bottled provides an evaluation protocol in which agents receive the entire unlabelled workload upfront and must return answers under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. They choose how to allocate these resources and whether to train a small model, write a program, or use a hybrid approach. We provide zero-shot LLM evaluation and a distillation baseline with the same token budget as the agents, alongside initial experimental results to support comparisons across agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Bottled，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体“装瓶”能力的基准。Bottled 提供了一套评估协议：智能体需一次性接收全部未标注的工作任务，并在固定的时间、计算资源和 LLM API 预算限制下返回答案。它们需要自行决定如何分配这些资源，以及是否训练一个小模型、编写程序或采用混合方法。我们还提供了零样本 LLM 评估和蒸馏基线模型，其令牌预算与智能体相同，并附上了初步的实验结果，以支持不同智能体之间的比较。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that strong zero-shot performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models that perform well when queried separately for each instance can struggle to turn those capabilities into an effective solution under a limited budget. On MAVE, GPT 5.6 Terra and Sonnet 5 both achieve zero-shot F1 scores of approximately 0.44, but their mean bottled F1 scores differ substantially: 0.405 and 0.154, respectively. This gap suggests that bottling requires capabilities beyond those measured by zero-shot task evaluation. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，强大的零样本性能并不一定能可靠地转化为强大的“装瓶”能力。当对每个实例单独进行查询时表现良好的模型，在预算有限的情况下可能难以将这些能力转化为有效的解决方案。在 MAVE 数据集上，GPT 5.6 Terra 和 Sonnet 5 的零样本 F1 分数均约为 0.44，但它们的平均“装瓶”后 F1 分数却存在显著差异：分别为 0.405 和 0.154。这一差距表明，“装瓶”过程需要超越零样本任务评估所衡量能力的其他技能。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Bottled , providing a basis for developing models and harnesses that can judge when, how and how much to invest in reusable artifacts for repetitive workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Bottled，为开发能够判断何时、如何以及投入多少资源用于重复性工作负载中可重用人工制品的模型和工具提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Using Bottled , we study the bottling capabilities of 10 models across 3 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 Bottled，我们研究了 10 个模型在 3 项任务中的装瓶能力。

paragraphs.en: Our analysis reveals that task knowledge does not guarantee bottling capability, and that many modern agents are often beaten by a naive distillation baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析表明，任务知识并不保证具备瓶颈能力，而且许多现代智能体常常会被一个简单的蒸馏基线所击败。

paragraphs.en: Our work lies at the intersection of four lines of research: benchmarking ML automation, amortizing repeated LLM calls, packaging LLM capabilities into reusable solutions, and automating large repetitive workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作位于四条研究路线的交叉点：机器学习自动化的基准测试、重复性 LLM 调用的摊销、将 LLM 能力封装为可重用的解决方案，以及大型重复性工作负载的自动化。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking ML automation. Prior work evaluates LLM agents on increasingly complex ML and software engineering tasks, including ML experimentation ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and Kaggle competitions ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , software-engineering ( Rein et al., 2025 ) , open-ended ML research ( Wijk et al., 2024 ) , and specialized tasks such as LLM post-training ( Rank et al., 2026 ) , paper reproduction ( Starace et al., 2025 ) , algorithm discovery ( Press et al., 2026 ) , and inference optimization ( Yeon et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, Bottled evaluates whether an agent can package capabilities of a general-purpose LLM into a reusable, task-specific solution that can be applied cheaply across a large workload to amortize LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: ML自动化的基准测试。先前的工作通过让LLM智能体执行日益复杂的ML和软件工程任务来对其进行评估，包括ML实验（Huang等，2023）和Kaggle竞赛（Chan等，2025）、软件工程（Rein等，2025）、开放式ML研究（Wijk等，2024），以及诸如LLM后训练（Rank等，2026）、论文复现（Starace等，2025）、算法发现（Press等，2026）和推理优化（Yeon等，2026）等专业任务。相比之下，Bottled评估的是：一个智能体是否能够将通用LLM的能力封装成可重复使用的、针对特定任务的解决方案，从而能够以低成本应用于大规模工作负载，以实现LLM调用的摊销。

paragraphs.en: Amortization of LLM calls. Existing work reduces repeated LLM inference cost through several mechanisms: distilling capabilities into smaller models ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Shirgaonkar et al., 2024 ; Belcak et al., 2025 ) , combining large and small models in collaborative systems ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , compressing models directly ( Jha et al., 2023 ) , and routing queries among models with different costs and capabilities ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ) , expert submodels ( Cai et al., 2024 ) or layers ( Heakl et al., 2026 ) . Bottled does not prescribe an amortization mechanism. It evaluates whether an agent can itself decide how to package its capabilities into a cheaper reusable solution for an entire workload, while balancing upfront construction cost, downstream inference cost, and task quality.
paragraphs.zh: LLM调用的摊销。现有研究通过多种机制降低了重复的LLM推理成本：将能力蒸馏到更小的模型中（Jiang等，2023；Shirgaonkar等，2024；Belcak等，2025）；在协作系统中结合大模型和小模型（Chen等，2025）；直接压缩模型（Jha等，2023）；以及在具有不同成本和能力的模型之间路由查询（Nguyen等，2024），或使用专家子模型（Cai等，2024）或层（Heakl等，2026）。Bottled并未规定特定的摊销机制。它评估的是：一个智能体是否能够自行决定如何将其能力封装成一种更廉价且可重复使用的解决方案，以应对整个工作负载，同时平衡初始构建成本、下游推理成本和任务质量。

paragraphs.en: Packaging LLM capabilities into reusable solutions. Many works distill agent trajectories as natural language descriptions ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , as executable code ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Naik et al., 2026 ) , or as APIs discovered through web exploration ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . We view these methods as partial forms of bottling. In Bottled , by contrast, the agent sees the entire unlabeled workload up front, before generating any trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 将 LLM 的能力封装为可重用的解决方案。许多研究将智能体轨迹提炼为自然语言描述（Wang 等人，2025b）、可执行代码（Wang 等人，2025a；Huang 等人，2026；Naik 等人，2026），或通过网页探索发现的 API（Zheng 等人，2025）。我们认为这些方法只是“封装”的部分形式。相比之下，在 Bottled 中，智能体在生成任何轨迹之前，会先看到整个未标记的工作负载。

paragraphs.en: Large and repetitive workloads. Prior work studies large repetitive workloads from several directions. Robotic process automation (RPA) uses LLMs, supervised learning, and workflow orchestration to automate high-volume processes such as document processing ( Baviskar et al., 2021 ) , invoice extraction ( Bhardwaj et al., 2024 ) , and recruitment ( Younes et al., 2025 ) . ScaleDoc ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) studies applying LLM-based predicates over large document collections, while OS-Marathon ( Wu et al., 2026 ) benchmarks agents on long-horizon repetitive workflows. Wu et al. (2026) use a similar data setup to ours. However, they evaluate whether an agent can solve repetitive workflows spanning roughly 50–200 interaction steps, whereas we ask whether an agent can replace repeated general-purpose LLM calls over workloads of 2.6–5.6 million instances with a cheaper task-specific solution.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模且重复性的工作负载。先前的研究从多个角度探讨了大规模重复性工作负载。机器人流程自动化（RPA）利用大语言模型（LLM）、监督学习和工作流编排来自动化高吞吐量流程，例如文档处理（Baviskar 等人，2021）、发票提取（Bhardwaj 等人，2024）和招聘（Younes 等人，2025）。ScaleDoc（Zhang 等人，2026）研究了在大型文档集合中应用基于 LLM 的谓词的方法，而 OS-Marathon（Wu 等人，2026）则对智能体在长期重复性工作流中的表现进行了基准测试。Wu 等人（2026）采用的数据设置与我们的类似。然而，他们评估的是智能体是否能够解决大约包含 50–200 个交互步骤的重复性工作流，而我们关注的是：对于包含 260 万至 560 万个实例的工作负载，智能体是否能够通过一种成本更低的特定任务解决方案，取代反复调用通用型大语言模型的做法。

paragraphs.en: Bottled tests whether autonomous agents can develop a cheap way to solve a large batch of instances of a narrow task, given fixed time, compute, and API budgets. We call this process bottling . We formalise the setting below.
paragraphs.zh: Bottled 测试了自主智能体是否能在固定的时间、计算资源和 API 预算下，为某一特定任务的大量实例找到一种低成本解决方案。我们将这一过程称为“bottling”。我们在下文对该设定进行了形式化描述。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate Bottled with 3 natural language tasks that mirror repetitive workloads found in real-world scenarios, such as e-commerce catalogue processing and content moderation. We select narrow tasks that each come with millions of labelled instances, such that running a frontier model on the full workload is prohibitively expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 3 项自然语言任务来实例化 Bottled，这些任务反映了现实场景中常见的重复性工作负载，例如电子商务目录处理和内容审核。我们选择了每个任务都包含数百万个带标签样本的特定任务，因此，在完整的工作负载上运行前沿模型的成本会高得令人望而却步。

paragraphs.en: Attribute extraction. The Multi-source Attribute Value Extraction dataset (MAVE) ( Yang et al., 2022 ) contains approximately 4.77 million product-attribute pairs from Amazon listings. Given an attribute name (e.g., material ) and the text of a product listing, the model must return the attribute’s value exactly as it appears in the listing. In approximately 1.78 million pairs, the listing does not state the attribute, and the model must abstain by returning a dedicated no-value token. We evaluate with F1 over all predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 属性提取。多源属性值提取数据集（MAVE）（Yang 等人，2022）包含来自亚马逊商品页面的约 477 万个产品-属性对。给定一个属性名称（例如，“材质”）和商品页面的文本，模型必须返回该属性在页面中出现的原始值。在约 178 万个属性对中，商品页面并未提及该属性，此时模型必须通过返回一个专用的“无值”标记来拒绝回答。我们使用所有预测结果的 F1 分数进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Query-product relevance classification. The Amazon Shopping Queries dataset (ESCI) ( Reddy et al., 2022 ) contains approximately 2.62 million query-product pairs. Given a shopper’s search query and a product’s details, the model must classify the product’s relevance to the query as Exact (E), Substitute (S), Complement (C), or Irrelevant (I). As the dataset is class-imbalanced, our main evaluation metric is the macro-F1 score over all class predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 查询-产品相关性分类。亚马逊购物查询数据集（ESCI）（Reddy 等人，2022）包含约 262 万个查询-产品对。给定购物者的搜索查询和产品的详细信息，模型必须将产品与查询的相关性分类为“完全匹配”（E）、“替代品”（S）、“互补品”（C）或“不相关”（I）。由于该数据集存在类别不平衡问题，我们的主要评估指标是所有类别预测的宏 F1 分数。

paragraphs.en: AI detection. The Robust AI Detection dataset (RAID) ( Dugan et al., 2024 ) contains approximately 5.62 million documents written either by humans or by language models, and was designed to stress-test detectors across domains, generator models, decoding strategies, and adversarial attacks. Given a document, the model must output its confidence that the document was generated by a language model. We evaluate with the area under the ROC curve (AUROC).
paragraphs.zh: AI 检测。Robust AI Detection 数据集（RAID）（Dugan 等人，2024）包含约 562 万份由人类或语言模型撰写的文档，旨在对跨领域、生成模型、解码策略和对抗性攻击的检测器进行压力测试。给定一篇文档，模型必须输出其对该文档由语言模型生成的置信度。我们使用 ROC 曲线下面积（AUROC）进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation setup is extendable to any given LLM operating inside an agentic harness. All experiments use the same harness, OpenCode, as this allows us to disentangle the influence of the harness ( Emde et al., 2026 ) from the capabilities of the underlying LLMs. Each agent has access to a single NVIDIA A100 GPU with 40GB of VRAM and 8 CPU cores with 64GB of RAM, starting from a base Python environment with basic utilities in which it may freely install additional packages. Following prior work on autonomous agentic tasks ( Rank et al., 2026 ) , each run has a time budget of 10 hours. Each run also has a token budget of 5 million tokens. Since different types of tokens contribute unequally to inference costs, our token accounting weights them accordingly: output tokens count twice as much as uncached input tokens, while cached input tokens count one-tenth as much ( Equation 1 ). The agent can check its remaining time and tokens at any point through MCP tools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估设置可以扩展至任何在智能体框架内运行的特定大型语言模型（LLM）。所有实验均使用相同的框架——OpenCode，这使我们能够将框架的影响（Emde 等人，2026）与底层 LLM 的能力区分开来。每个智能体均可使用一台配备 40GB VRAM 的 NVIDIA A100 GPU 和一颗配备 64GB RAM 的 8 核 CPU，并从包含基本工具的初始 Python 环境开始，该环境中可自由安装额外包。遵循先前关于自主智能体任务的研究（Rank 等人，2026），每次运行的时间预算为 10 小时，令牌预算为 500 万个令牌。由于不同类型的令牌对推理成本的贡献不同，我们的令牌计算方式会相应地对其赋予权重：输出令牌的计数是未缓存输入令牌的两倍，而缓存输入令牌的计数仅为十分之一（公式 1）。智能体可以通过 MCP 工具随时检查其剩余时间和令牌数量。

paragraphs.en: Beyond local compute, the agent may call its own model’s Completions API, and these calls count against the token budget. We restrict each agent to the API of the LLM being evaluated (e.g., Claude Sonnet 5 cannot query Claude Opus 5, or vice versa), so that future models do not benefit simply from access to a larger pool of models. Otherwise, the agent has unrestricted internet access, routed through a proxy that lets us control and track its use of online resources. To prevent label leakage, the proxy blocks URLs hosting the benchmark datasets or models trained directly on their labels, returning the message, “This resource is prohibited. Do not attempt to circumvent.” As it is possible that our blocklist missed some sources of leakage, we further audited all runs for contamination using an agentic judge: see Appendix D for details.
paragraphs.zh: 除了本地计算能力之外，智能体还可以调用其自身模型的 Completions API，而这些调用会占用令牌配额。我们将每个智能体的调用限制在正在评估的 LLM 所对应的 API 范围内（例如，Claude Sonnet 5 无法查询 Claude Opus 5，反之亦然），以确保未来的模型不会仅仅因为能够访问更大的模型池而获得优势。此外，该智能体还拥有不受限制的互联网访问权限，但所有流量均通过代理服务器进行路由，以便我们能够控制并追踪其对在线资源的使用情况。为防止标签泄露，该代理服务器会阻止指向基准数据集或直接在数据集标签上训练的模型的 URL，并返回如下信息：“此资源被禁止使用。请勿尝试绕过限制。”由于我们的黑名单可能遗漏了某些泄露源，我们还进一步利用一个智能体裁判对所有运行过程进行了污染检查：详见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Before either budget runs out, the agent must write its predictions for every instance in the workload to a single file, out.txt . Once a budget is exhausted, the harness terminates the run. We then score out.txt against the labels of the corresponding dataset. If the file is missing or incomplete, every missing prediction is replaced with a task-specific fallback answer that carries no information about the instance: an empty string for MAVE, a uniformly sampled label for ESCI, and a confidence of 0.5 0.5 for RAID. As a result, an agent that delivers nothing receives the same score as one that answers uninformatively.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何预算耗尽之前，智能体必须将工作负载中每个实例的预测结果写入单个文件 out.txt。一旦某个预算用尽，测试框架就会终止运行。随后，我们会根据对应数据集的标签对 out.txt 进行评分。如果该文件缺失或不完整，所有缺失的预测都会被替换为特定任务的备用答案，这些答案不包含关于该实例的任何信息：MAVE 使用空字符串，ESCI 使用均匀采样的标签，RAID 则使用置信度为 0.5 的答案。因此，一个没有任何输出的智能体，其得分将与一个提供无信息量答案的智能体相同。

paragraphs.en: The zero-shot mode of evaluation forms the reference point for the underlying LLM’s knowledge of the given task. The LLM receives one instance of the task at a time, i.e., a task specification followed by each instance; the answer is generated in a non-agentic setup (i.e., via next token generation, without tool usage), see also Section 3.1 . As zero-shot evaluation on the full workload is prohibitively expensive, we uniformly sample 1000 instances from the full workload. Each LLM receives the same 1000 instances. If the LLM provides an unparseable answer where only certain answers are legal (e.g., an explanation where a number was required, a content-policy-based refusal, and so on), the answer is replaced with a fallback (see Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 零样本评估模式为底层 LLM 对给定任务的知识提供了参考基准。LLM 每次接收一个任务实例，即先接收任务说明，再接收具体实例；答案在非智能体模式下生成（即通过生成下一个词元，不使用工具），另请参见第 3.1 节。由于对整个工作负载进行零样本评估的成本过高，我们从完整工作负载中统一采样了 1000 个实例。每个 LLM 都接收到相同的 1000 个实例。如果 LLM 提供的答案无法解析，而某些特定类型的答案是合法的（例如，需要数字时提供了解释、基于内容政策的拒绝等），则该答案将被替换为备用答案（参见第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: While the zero-shot baseline measures the underlying LLM’s knowledge of the task, running it on the full workload costs orders of magnitude more than the bottling budget. We therefore add a baseline that spends the same 5 million tokens as a bottler, without any agentic decision-making. We use GLM 5.3 Flash to label instances sampled uniformly from the full workload, prompted as in the zero-shot mode, until the token budget is exhausted under the same accounting as in Section 3.3 . We then finetune two small language models (SLMs), Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct (labelled “SmolLM2-360M-it” in figures for brevity), on the resulting labels, and apply them to the full workload. Training and inference hyperparameters follow published recipes and model cards, without any tuning, so that the baseline stays as naive as possible. This baseline asks whether assigning the task to an autonomous agent does better than spending the same tokens on a fixed, task-agnostic distillation script. Details are in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然零样本基线模型衡量的是底层大语言模型（LLM）对该任务的基础知识，但将其运行于完整工作负载上的成本比“装瓶”预算高出几个数量级。因此，我们增加了一个基线模型：该模型与“装瓶器”一样消耗相同的 500 万个 token，但不进行任何智能体式的决策。我们使用 GLM 5.3 Flash 对从完整工作负载中均匀采样的实例进行标注，提示方式与零样本模式相同，直至在遵循第 3.3 节的相同计算规则下耗尽 token 预算。随后，我们在这些标注结果上微调两个小型语言模型（SLM）：Qwen3-0.6B 和 SmolLM2-360M-Instruct（为简洁起见，在图中将其标记为“SmolLM2-360M-it”），并将它们应用于完整工作负载。训练和推理的超参数均遵循已发表的方案与模型说明卡，未经任何调整，以确保该基线尽可能保持原始状态。这一基线旨在探究：将任务分配给一个自主智能体，是否比用相同的 token 量运行一个固定的、与任务无关的蒸馏脚本表现更优。更多细节见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 10 models on 3 tasks, each in both zero-shot and bottled mode, and ask how much of an LLM’s zero-shot performance its bottled artifact retains, and at what cost. Figure 2 reports per-task results in each task’s native metric. Zero-shot scores are computed on the 1000-instance sample of each task, with 95% bootstrap CIs over 2000 resamples. Bottled scores are means over two independent runs per model and task. Figure 1 reports the aggregate relative gain R ⁡ ( M ) R(M) defined in Section 3.4 . Section 4.1 presents our main findings, and Section 4.3 then presents an ablation where we relax the budget constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 3 项任务上评估了 10 个模型，每项任务均在零样本和瓶装模式下进行测试，并探究 LLM 的零样本性能中有多少能被其瓶装产物保留，以及这一过程需要付出怎样的代价。图 2 报告了各项任务在其原生指标下的结果。零样本分数基于每项任务的 1000 个实例样本计算得出，并通过 2000 次重采样获得了 95% 的自助置信区间。瓶装分数则是每个模型和任务在两次独立运行中的平均值。图 1 报告了第 3.4 节中定义的聚合相对增益 R(M)。第 4.1 节将呈现我们的主要发现，而第 4.3 节则会展示我们在放宽预算约束条件下的消融分析。

paragraphs.en: Models with similar zero-shot performance can vary wildly in bottling capabilities. We compare the ranges of zero-shot and bottling performance ( Figure 2 ). On MAVE, zero-shot F1s range only between 0.426 and 0.510, all models well above the trivial baseline of zero F1. By bottled F1, on the other hand, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite lies close to the trivial baseline while Opus 5 competes with the zero-shot F1 range at 0.461. In fact, the ranges of bottled scores are more than 5 × 5\times , 3 × 3\times and 2 × 2\times as large as the ranges of the zero-shot scores on MAVE, ESCI and RAID, respectively. On MAVE ( Figure 2 , leftmost), GPT 5.6 Terra and Sonnet 5 both achieve zero-shot F1 close to 0.44. Yet, GPT 5.6 Terra achieves an average bottled F1 of 0.405, while Sonnet 5 reaches only 0.154. Similarly, on ESCI ( Figure 2 , middle), GLM 5.3 and GPT 5.6 Terra have similar zero-shot macro F1s of 0.593 and 0.573 respectively, yet their bottled macro F1s lie at 0.497 and 0.265 respectively: GLM 5.3 retains almost 84% of its zero-shot performance while GPT 5.6 Terra retains only about 46%. Models that appear similar when evaluated zero-shot indeed behave very differently when asked to bottle the same knowledge into an artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 在零样本性能相近的模型之间，其知识封装能力可能存在巨大差异。我们对零样本性能和知识封装性能的分布范围进行了比较（图2）。在MAVE数据集上，零样本F1值的范围仅在0.426至0.510之间，所有模型的表现都明显高于零F1这一简单基线。然而，就封装后的F1值而言，Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite的表现接近简单基线，而Opus 5的封装后F1值达到0.461，与零样本F1值的范围相当。事实上，在MAVE、ESCI和RAID数据集上，封装后分数的分布范围分别是零样本分数分布范围的5倍以上、3倍以上和2倍以上。在MAVE数据集上（图2，最左侧），GPT 5.6 Terra和Sonnet 5的零样本F1值均接近0.44。然而，GPT 5.6 Terra的平均封装后F1值为0.405，而Sonnet 5仅为0.154。同样地，在ESCI数据集上（图2，中间），GLM 5.3和GPT 5.6 Terra的零样本宏观F1值分别为0.593和0.573，较为接近；但它们的封装后宏观F1值分别为0.497和0.265：GLM 5.3保留了其零样本性能的约84%，而GPT 5.6 Terra仅保留了约46%。那些在零样本评估中表现相似的模型，在尝试将相同知识封装到特定产物中时，实际上会表现出截然不同的行为。

paragraphs.en: Bottling usually falls well short of zero-shot performance. We compare each bottling run against the 95% CI of the underlying LLM’s zero-shot performance on the same task. Over our full suite of experiments (10 models, 3 tasks, 2 runs; see Figure 2 ), 48 out of 60 bottling runs underperform their corresponding zero-shot 95% CIs while 40 out of 60 underperform even the worst zero-shot model’s 95% CI for the corresponding task. We also compare the bottling vs zero-shot aggregate relative gains over the trivial baseline in Figure 1 , left. Opus 5 tops the bottling leaderboard with an aggregate relative gain of about 42%, followed by GLM 5.3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro at about 39% each. All three fall well below their zero-shot aggregate relative gains of approximately 61%, 54% and 59% respectively. At the bottom, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite lies close to the trivial baseline at only about 5% bottled relative gain, while its zero-shot relative gain is close to 47%. Even the best bottlers lose over a quarter of their zero-shot performance on average; the worst bottlers lose close to 90% of it. In general, bottling under our settings does not yet fully preserve the underlying LLM’s zero-shot capability.
paragraphs.zh: 模型压缩的性能通常远低于零样本性能。我们将每次模型压缩的运行结果与基础大语言模型在同一任务上的零样本性能的95%置信区间进行比较。在我们完整的实验系列中（10个模型、3项任务、2次运行；参见图2），60次模型压缩运行中有48次的表现低于其对应的零样本95%置信区间，而其中40次的表现甚至低于对应任务中最差的零样本模型的95%置信区间。我们在图1左侧还比较了模型压缩与零样本方法相对于简单基线的综合相对增益。Opus 5在模型压缩排行榜中位居第一，综合相对增益约为42%，其次是GLM 5.3 Flash和Gemini 3.1 Pro，两者均约为39%。这三者的表现都远低于其各自的零样本综合相对增益（分别为约61%、54%和59%）。在排名末尾，Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite的表现接近简单基线，模型压缩后的相对增益仅为约5%，而它的零样本相对增益则接近47%。即便是表现最佳的模型压缩方法，其平均性能也损失了超过四分之一的零样本能力；而表现最差的方法则损失了近90%。总体而言，在我们设定的条件下，模型压缩尚未能完全保留基础大语言模型的零样本能力。

paragraphs.en: Expensive solutions are not necessarily better. In Table 1 , we compare bottling performance with the estimated costs (in US dollars) for running the agents. GLM 5.3 Flash delivers an aggregate relative gain of about 39% for less than $1, dominating every more expensive model 3 3 3 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite lies on the frontier only by being the cheapest model; its gain is near-trivial at 5%. except for Opus 5 with an aggregate relative gain of about 42% at approximately $29, over 35 times as expensive. GPT 5.6 Sol delivers only about a 6% aggregate relative gain despite costing about $12, over 14 times as expensive as GLM 5.3 Flash. Drastic cost differences can therefore emerge among models with similar bottling capabilities, although this inference also depends on provider pricing decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 昂贵的解决方案并不一定更好。在表 1 中，我们将装瓶性能与运行这些智能体的预估成本（以美元计）进行了比较。GLM 5.3 Flash 的总相对增益约为 39%，而成本不到 1 美元，在所有更昂贵的模型中均表现最优。Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 之所以位于前沿，仅仅是因为它是最便宜的模型；其增益仅为 5%，几乎可以忽略不计。Opus 5 除外，其总相对增益约为 42%，但成本高达约 29 美元，是前者的 35 倍多。尽管 GPT 5.6 Sol 的成本约为 12 美元，是 GLM 5.3 Flash 的 14 倍多，但其总相对增益仅为约 6%。因此，在装瓶能力相近的模型之间，可能会出现巨大的成本差异，尽管这种推断也取决于提供商的定价决策。

paragraphs.en: Bottling is often outperformed by a naive distillation baseline. To contextualize the bottling performance of LLM agents, we consider two SLM students (Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct) distilled from GLM 5.3 Flash, using as many labels as can be obtained until 5 million tokens are exhausted. In Figure 2 , we plot their mean scores (over three independent runs) in the given task’s native metric. We note that in total, 31 out of 60 bottling runs underperform the better student for a given task, while 21 out of 60 underperform both students. We finetuned and evaluated both students under standard settings without any task-specific tuning (see Appendix B ); it is therefore striking that they are able to beat autonomous agents at all, and so often. From the practitioner’s perspective, allocating a given token budget to an autonomous agent may end up yielding worse performance than a naive distillation baseline using the same budget.
paragraphs.zh: “装瓶”方法通常表现不如简单的蒸馏基线。为了说明 LLM 智能体的“装瓶”性能，我们考虑了两个从 GLM 5.3 Flash 蒸馏而来的 SLM 学生模型（Qwen3-0.6B 和 SmolLM2-360M-Instruct），在消耗完 500 万个 token 之前尽可能多地使用可用标签。在图 2 中，我们绘制了它们在给定任务的原生指标上的平均得分（基于三次独立运行）。我们注意到，在总共 60 次“装瓶”运行中，有 31 次的表现不如某个表现更优的学生模型，而 21 次的表现则不如两个学生模型。我们在标准设置下对这两个学生模型进行了微调与评估，并未进行任何任务特定的调整（参见附录 B）；因此，它们能够击败自主智能体，而且如此频繁，这一点令人印象深刻。从实践者的角度来看，将给定的 token 预算分配给一个自主智能体，最终可能会比使用相同预算的简单蒸馏基线产生更差的性能。

paragraphs.en: It is possible for bottled solutions to retain nearly all of the corresponding zero-shot performance. While many bottling runs underperform the naive distillation script, some are notably competitive with the zero-shot baseline. In our current experiments, 6 out of 60 bottling runs recovered at least 95% of the corresponding zero-shot performance. From Figure 2 (leftmost panel), Opus 5 on MAVE reached a mean bottled F1 of 0.461 at an estimated cost of $31.40, compared to Opus 5’s zero-shot F1 of 0.483 at an estimated full workload cost of $27,914. This amounts to recovering over 95% of the zero-shot solution’s performance at a roughly 889-fold lower cost. These results demonstrate that incredibly effective bottling is possible within our budgets, although not uniformly across models and tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 瓶装解决方案有可能保留几乎全部对应的零样本性能。尽管许多瓶装过程的表现不如简单的蒸馏脚本，但其中一些与零样本基线相比具有明显的竞争力。在我们当前的实验中，60 次瓶装运行中有 6 次恢复了至少 95% 的对应零样本性能。从图 2（最左侧面板）可以看出，Opus 5 在 MAVE 任务上实现了平均瓶装 F1 值为 0.461，估计成本为 31.40 美元；而 Opus 5 的零样本 F1 值为 0.483，完整工作负载的估计成本为 27,914 美元。这意味着以大约低 889 倍的成本，恢复了零样本解决方案超过 95% 的性能。这些结果表明，在我们的预算范围内可以实现极其高效的瓶装，尽管不同模型和任务的效果并不一致。

paragraphs.en: Agents sometimes exhaust their budgets without delivering the required output. Of the 60 bottling runs, 21 were stopped by the harness upon reaching the token budget; eight of these had not fulfilled the completion contract (i.e., delivery of out.txt ). GPT 5.6 Sol accounted for four of these eight failures; the remainder came from Qwen 3.8 Flash, Sonnet 5, Opus 5, and GLM 5.3. These failures occurred despite access to budget-tracking tools and explicit instructions that the harness would terminate once either limit was reached (see Appendix C ). In one MAVE run, GPT 5.6 Sol reasoned (quoting from OpenAI’s summary of the reasoning), “I need to run some calculations while keeping an eye on the budget to ensure I don’t exceed it.” It then launched a script to label thousands of samples through sequential API calls; the budget was exhausted soon afterwards. Evidently, even very capable agents may sometimes consume significant resources and deliver no output at the end, which is arguably worse than delivering a suboptimal one.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体有时会在未交付所需输出的情况下耗尽预算。在 60 次装瓶运行中，有 21 次因达到令牌预算上限而被框架终止；其中 8 次未能履行完成合同（即交付 out.txt）。GPT 5.6 Sol 导致了这 8 次失败中的 4 次；其余的则来自 Qwen 3.8 Flash、Sonnet 5、Opus 5 和 GLM 5.3。尽管这些智能体可以使用预算跟踪工具，并且明确收到指示称一旦达到任一限制，框架就会终止运行（参见附录 C），但这些失败仍然发生了。在一次 MAVE 运行中，GPT 5.6 Sol 进行了如下推理（引自 OpenAI 对推理过程的总结）：“我需要一边进行一些计算，一边留意预算，以确保不会超出预算。”随后，它启动了一个脚本，通过连续调用 API 为数千个样本添加标签；不久之后，预算便已耗尽。显然，即便是能力很强的智能体，有时也可能消耗大量资源却最终毫无产出，而这或许比交付一个次优的结果更糟糕。

paragraphs.en: We compare bottling with TypeSafe AI’s recently released Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Marketed as a “system one” model, Jev is designed to make fast, computationally cheap decisions over text inputs, with input tokens costing a fraction of the cheapest LLM and output tokens unmetered ( Almeida, 2026 ) . While Jev cannot replace an LLM in an agentic harness (such as our bottling setup), it provides a promising alternative to expensive LLM inference, so we investigate whether zero-shot inference using Jev can be competitive with bottling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“bottling”与 TypeSafe AI 最近发布的 Jev（Almeida，2026）进行了比较。Jev 被宣传为一种“系统一”模型，旨在对文本输入做出快速且计算成本低的决策：其输入令牌的成本仅为最便宜 LLM 的一小部分，而输出令牌则不收取费用（Almeida，2026）。尽管 Jev 无法在智能体框架中取代 LLM（例如我们的“bottling”配置），但它为昂贵的 LLM 推理提供了一种有前景的替代方案。因此，我们研究了使用 Jev 进行零样本推理是否能够在性能上与“bottling”相竞争。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Jev on the same 1000 samples used for the zero-shot baseline. Jev cannot generate free text and therefore cannot be used with MAVE; this baseline is limited to ESCI and RAID. We use the choice and noul question types for ESCI and RAID respectively; see Appendix E for details and Figure 3 for the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在用于零样本基线的相同 1000 个样本上对 Jev 进行了评估。Jev 无法生成自由文本，因此不能与 MAVE 一起使用；该基线仅限于 ESCI 和 RAID。我们分别使用 choice 和 noul 问题类型进行 ESCI 和 RAID 的测试；详细信息请参见附录 E，结果请参见图 3。

paragraphs.en: Bottling is competitive with Jev. On ESCI, Opus 5 as a bottler achieves a macro-F1 of 0.499 compared to Jev’s zero-shot estimate of 0.531, retaining about 94% of Jev’s score at an estimated 25% of its projected full-workload cost ($26.28 vs. $104.89). Similarly, on RAID, Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves a mean AUROC of 0.822, over 97% of Jev’s AUROC estimate of 0.846, at only about 2% of the cost ($4.69 vs. $223.16). This comparison is particularly encouraging for bottling when one considers workloads even larger than ours: Jev’s cost must necessarily increase linearly with workload size, whereas bottling can potentially reuse computation across instances, allowing its cost to grow more slowly. Further, as noted above, bottling can also be used for generative tasks (e.g., MAVE) where Jev cannot be applied. We view these results as placing agentic bottling and system one models in competition along the performance–cost frontier.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体蒸馏在与 Jev 的竞争中表现不俗。在 ESCI 数据集上，作为蒸馏模型的 Opus 5 实现了 0.499 的宏观 F1 分数，而 Jev 的零样本估计值为 0.531；这意味着 Opus 5 保留了 Jev 得分的约 94%，同时其预估的全工作量成本仅为后者的 25%（26.28 美元 vs. 104.89 美元）。同样地，在 RAID 数据集上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 实现了 0.822 的平均 AUROC，超过了 Jev 的 0.846 的 AUROC 估计值的 97%，而成本仅为其约 2%（4.69 美元 vs. 223.16 美元）。考虑到比我们所测试的工作量更大的任务时，这种对比对智能体蒸馏而言尤其令人鼓舞：Jev 的成本必然随工作量规模线性增长，而智能体蒸馏则有可能在不同实例间复用计算资源，从而使其成本增长更为缓慢。此外，如前所述，智能体蒸馏还可用于生成式任务（例如 MAVE），而这些任务是 Jev 无法处理的。我们认为这些结果表明，智能体蒸馏模型与系统一模型在性能–成本边界上已形成了直接竞争。

paragraphs.en: All of our main results are obtained under a fixed API budget of 5 million tokens; many agent runs exhausted this budget and were stopped by the harness. Here, we look at such runs more closely.
paragraphs.zh: 我们所有的核心结果都是在固定的 500 万词元 API 预算下获得的；许多智能体运行过程耗尽了这一预算，并被测试框架终止。在此，我们将更详细地分析此类运行过程。

paragraphs.en: Motivation: how much did agents lose to the budget constraint? In our evaluation setup, agents receive a mark_task_complete tool, using which they may submit their answers and stop the harness. Of the 60 bottling runs, 21 were stopped because of budget exhaustion before they could stop the harness voluntarily. We will refer to these runs as “budget-terminated” runs. Although delivering the output within budget is an important part of our evaluation, we analyze whether these agents would have produced better solutions if allowed to continue beyond the budget.
paragraphs.zh: 动机：智能体因预算限制而损失了多少？在我们的评估设置中，智能体会获得一个 mark_task_complete 工具，通过该工具，它们可以提交答案并停止运行器。在 60 次装瓶运行中，有 21 次由于预算耗尽而被提前终止，未能自行停止运行器。我们将这些运行称为“预算终止”运行。尽管在预算内交付输出是我们评估的重要组成部分，但我们还要分析：如果允许这些智能体超出预算继续运行，它们是否会产生更优的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We repeated all 21 budget-terminated runs under settings identical to those of the original experiments. While the budgets were still stated, we disabled the termination of the harness at budget exhaustion. With the new runs replacing their counterparts in our 60 original runs, we recomputed each model’s mean per-task bottled performance.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。我们在与原实验完全相同的设置下，重复了所有 21 次预算终止运行。尽管预算限制仍然存在，但我们禁用了在预算耗尽时终止测试框架的机制。用这些新的运行结果替换我们最初 60 次运行中的对应结果后，我们重新计算了每个模型在每个任务上的平均受限性能。

paragraphs.en: In general, there remains a bottling gap even after disabling budget termination. Figure 4 reports the shift in each model’s mean bottling performance per task. We confirm that in total, after replacing budget-terminated runs with their corresponding ablation reruns, 47 (vs. 48 originally) out of 60 runs still lie below the 95% CI of the corresponding LLM’s zero-shot performance. Notably, GPT 5.6 Sol on ESCI gains only 0.074 in macro F1, still reaching only about 49% of its zero-shot macro F1, comparable to its smaller sibling GPT 5.6 Terra (mean bottled macro F1 of 0.265). Thus, allowing budget overruns does not suffice to match the underlying LLM’s entire zero-shot performance.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，即使禁用预算终止机制后，仍然存在性能瓶颈问题。图4报告了每个模型在各项任务中的平均瓶颈性能变化。我们确认，在将因预算终止而中断的运行替换为相应的消融重运行后，60次运行中仍有47次（最初为48次）低于对应LLM零样本性能的95%置信区间。值得注意的是，GPT 5.6 Sol在ESCI上的宏观F1仅提升了0.074，仍仅达到其零样本宏观F1的约49%，与其较小的版本GPT 5.6 Terra（平均受限宏观F1为0.265）相当。因此，允许预算超支并不足以匹配底层LLM的全部零样本性能。

paragraphs.en: Some agents improve substantially after disabling budget termination. From Figure 4 , Opus 5, originally with a mean bottling AUROC of 0.713 on RAID, reaches an AUROC of 0.929, surpassing its zero-shot performance. Similarly, GPT 5.6 Sol gains over 100% of its original bottling F1 on MAVE and reaches 0.386 (90% of its zero-shot F1); GPT 5.6 Sol also gains 60% of its original bottling AUROC on RAID to reach 0.800 (about 86% of its zero-shot performance). On the other hand, GPT 5.6 Sol on ESCI, as noted above, still lies at about 49% of its zero-shot macro F1. Poor budget tracking therefore caused some, but not all, agent runs to perform suboptimally.
paragraphs.zh: 部分智能体在禁用预算终止机制后表现显著提升。从图4可以看出，Opus 5最初在RAID数据集上的平均瓶颈AUROC为0.713，但在禁用预算终止后，其AUROC达到了0.929，超越了其零样本性能。同样地，GPT 5.6 Sol在MAVE数据集上的瓶颈F1值提升了超过其原始水平的100%，达到0.386（为其零样本F1值的90%）；在RAID数据集上，GPT 5.6 Sol的瓶颈AUROC也提升了原始水平的60%，达到0.800（约为其零样本性能的86%）。另一方面，如前所述，GPT 5.6 Sol在ESCI数据集上的表现仍仅为其零样本宏观F1值的约49%。因此，不准确的预算跟踪导致部分（但并非全部）智能体运行未能达到最优性能。

paragraphs.en: Agents can deliver poor solutions despite never running out of budget. Finally, we reiterate that 39 out of our 60 original agent runs terminated voluntarily after marking the task complete. Most notably, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite frequently marked the task complete early in the run. In one ESCI run, the agent used the read tool to examine the input file; the tool returned truncated output followed by a warning, “(Output capped at 50 KB. Showing lines 1-49. Use offset=50 to continue.)”. Ignoring this, the agent concluded that the workload only contained 49 instances while it contained millions. The agent delivered a partial output file with 49 answers, and marked the task complete with nearly 4.95 million tokens’ worth of budget left. Other models delivered poor solutions because of poor decision-making. In both MAVE runs, Sonnet 5 prompted an off-the-shelf SLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) over the full workload, without any finetuning. This turned out to deliver F1s of 0.194 and 0.113 respectively, compared to Sonnet 5’s zero-shot MAVE F1 of 0.444. The two runs had spent 4.68 and 1.00 million tokens respectively. Therefore, many weak solutions stem from failures unrelated to budget tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管预算从未耗尽，智能体仍可能提供糟糕的解决方案。最后，我们重申，在我们最初运行的 60 次智能体任务中，有 39 次在标记任务完成后主动终止。尤其值得注意的是，Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 经常在运行初期就标记任务完成。在一次 ESCI 运行中，该智能体使用读取工具检查输入文件；该工具返回了被截断的输出，并附带警告：“（输出上限为 50 KB。显示第 1-49 行。使用 offset=50 继续。）”。但智能体忽视了这一提示，认为工作负载仅包含 49 个实例，而实际上却包含数百万个。该智能体生成了一份包含 49 个答案的部分输出文件，并在还剩近 495 万个 token 的预算时标记任务完成。其他模型则因决策不当而提供了糟糕的解决方案。在两次 MAVE 运行中，Sonnet 5 均未进行任何微调，而是直接对工作负载的全部数据调用了一款现成的 SLM（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）。结果，其 F1 值分别为 0.194 和 0.113，远低于 Sonnet 5 的零样本 MAVE F1 值 0.444。这两次运行分别消耗了 468 万个和 100 万个 token。因此，许多低质量的解决方案源于与预算跟踪无关的问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Bottled to evaluate the ability of LLM agents to bottle task-specific knowledge into an artifact. We find that some modern LLM agents succeed at bottling on certain tasks, matching or even surpassing the zero-shot baseline at a fraction of its cost. However, for the majority of agents, bottled artifacts underperform the zero-shot baseline to varying degrees. More generally, competence at the zero-shot task does not guarantee the ability to solve it cheaply at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了 Bottled，以评估 LLM 智能体将特定任务知识封装到某个产物中的能力。我们发现，一些现代 LLM 智能体在某些任务上成功实现了封装，其表现与零样本基线相当，甚至更优，而成本却仅为后者的一小部分。然而，对于大多数智能体而言，封装后的产物在性能上以不同程度落后于零样本基线。更普遍地看，在零样本任务上的能力，并不保证能够以低成本大规模解决该任务。

paragraphs.en: Bottling is an important aspect of intelligence and a capability worth improving in current agents. Effective bottlers could automate mundane, large-scale repetitive tasks, which gives bottling great practical value. Most agents are not yet effective bottlers. Better models and harnesses should first avoid agentic failures, such as exhausting the token budget without any output, and then improve artifact quality. Bottled measures progress on both fronts.
paragraphs.zh: “装瓶”是智能体的一个重要方面，也是当前智能体值得提升的一项能力。高效的“装瓶者”能够自动化处理那些枯燥、大规模且重复性的任务，这使得“装瓶”具有极高的实用价值。目前大多数智能体还未能成为高效的“装瓶者”。更优秀的模型和工具应首先避免智能体层面的失败，例如在没有任何输出的情况下耗尽令牌预算，然后才能提升产出的质量。“装瓶”指标在这两个方面都取得了进展。

paragraphs.en: In the longer term, bottling matters beyond LLMs. General methods that scale with compute tend to overtake dedicated ones ( Sutton, 2019 ) . Therefore, the most capable system for a task is likely to be a large and expensive generalist. Through bottling, such a system can build dedicated solutions that retain its performance at a fraction of its cost, faster and at a larger scale than human experts could. As long as the most capable systems are also the most expensive, bottling will remain relevant, regardless of the underlying paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 从长远来看，智能体架构的瓶颈问题将超越大型语言模型（LLM）本身。那些能够随计算资源扩展的一般性方法，往往会超越专门设计的方法（Sutton, 2019）。因此，完成某项任务能力最强的系统，很可能是一个规模庞大且成本高昂的通用型智能体。通过构建瓶颈架构，这样的系统可以生成专门的解决方案，在仅消耗少量成本的情况下保持其性能，并且能够比人类专家更快、更大规模地实现这一目标。只要能力最强的系统同时也是成本最高的，那么无论底层范式如何变化，这种瓶颈架构都将持续具有重要意义。

paragraphs.en: This project was led by AS. All authors contributed to the conceptualization of the core idea, originating in a discussion between AS and AR. AS, HP, and AR developed the task selection and evaluation protocol, incorporating feedback from MG and SJO. AS was responsible for implementing and conducting the experiments. AS, HP and MG led the interpretation of the results and development of the central argument, with feedback from AR and SJO. paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to implement methods in code, and to design some aspects of the research methodology and experiments. Additionally, we used generative AI tools to create and modify scientific figures and to help with phrasing parts of the paper for better clarity. They were occasionally used to find related work.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用生成式人工智能工具将方法实现为代码，并用于设计研究方法和实验的某些方面。此外，我们还利用生成式人工智能工具创建和修改科学图表，并帮助润色论文中的部分内容以增强清晰度。偶尔，这些工具也被用来查找相关研究。

paragraphs.en: All code written by LLMs was reviewed. Code critical to results was reviewed even more carefully, with annotations to each region of the code stating the date of review. Experiments record git commits, in order to allow traceability. Coding agents were restricted via sandboxes from directly modifying critical artifacts such as the datasets and the results. The authors discussed the research methodology and experiments over regular meetings. All aspects of the experiments presented in this work were only finalized after being logically validated by the authors, independently of generative AI tools. Generative tools were used to visually enhance the figures; the correctness of the numbers therein was verified manually, multiple times, against raw data. Every number in the manuscript was checked by an author, to ensure that experiments were cited accurately.
paragraphs.zh: 所有由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码均经过审查。对结果具有关键作用的代码则进行了更为细致的审查，并在代码的每个区域添加了注释，注明了审查日期。实验记录中包含了 git 提交信息，以确保可追溯性。编码智能体通过沙箱机制受到限制，无法直接修改数据集和结果等关键成果。作者们通过定期会议讨论了研究方法和实验过程。本研究中呈现的所有实验内容，只有在经过作者独立于生成式人工智能工具的逻辑验证之后，才最终确定。生成式工具仅用于对图表进行视觉上的优化；其中数值的准确性则通过与原始数据多次手动核对得到验证。手稿中的每一个数字都经过作者的检查，以确保实验引用准确无误。

paragraphs.en: We have not used generative AI tools to help develop theoretical models or conceptual frameworks, propose or refine hypotheses, support qualitative and thematic data analysis, or interpret results. The remaining uses (generate synthetic data sets, formulate mathematical claims, provide critical ingredients for proving mathematical claims, assist in the writing of proofs, assist with translation, clean and reformat dataset) are not applicable to this work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们未使用生成式人工智能工具来协助开发理论模型或概念框架、提出或完善假设、支持定性及主题数据分析，或解释研究结果。其余用途（生成合成数据集、构建数学论断、为证明数学论断提供关键要素、协助撰写证明过程、协助翻译、清理和重新格式化数据集）均不适用于本研究。

paragraphs.en: We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对这项工作的最终内容负责，包括借助生成式人工智能生成的文本、主张或成果。

paragraphs.en: This work does not involve human subjects, and we collected no new data. All three tasks use publicly available datasets: MAVE ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , ESCI ( Reddy et al., 2022 ) and RAID ( Dugan et al., 2024 ) . We use them for research purposes in accordance with their licences (CC-BY-NC 4.0, Apache-2.0, and MIT, respectively).
paragraphs.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者，且我们未收集任何新数据。所有三项任务均使用公开可用的数据集：MAVE（Yang 等人，2022）、ESCI（Reddy 等人，2022）和 RAID（Dugan 等人，2024）。我们根据这些数据集的许可协议（分别为 CC-BY-NC 4.0、Apache-2.0 和 MIT）将其用于研究目的。

paragraphs.en: The agents in our experiments run autonomously for up to 10 hours with a GPU and internet access in a sandbox environment. To limit unintended behaviour, all traffic is routed through a proxy that logs requests and blocks resources that would leak benchmark labels, and each agent can call only the API of the model under evaluation ( Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们实验中的智能体在沙盒环境中，借助 GPU 和网络访问权限，可自主运行长达 10 小时。为限制意外行为，所有流量均通过代理服务器进行路由，该代理会记录请求并阻止可能泄露基准测试标签的资源；此外，每个智能体只能调用正在评估的模型所对应的 API（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Bottling aims to reduce the cost of solving large repetitive workloads. Replacing repeated calls to a frontier model with a cheap artifact also reduces the energy spent on inference, although running our benchmark itself consumes substantial compute. Cheaper automation could displace human work, and we believe our benchmark can help anticipate when this displacement may accelerate: by tracking how close agentic bottling comes to frontier-model quality at a fraction of the cost, it can give affected workers, employers and policymakers earlier warning to prepare, for example through retraining or support programmes.
paragraphs.zh: “智能体装瓶”旨在降低解决大型重复性工作负载的成本。用成本较低的产物替代对前沿模型的重复调用，也能减少推理所消耗的能量，尽管运行我们的基准测试本身就需要大量的计算资源。更廉价的自动化可能会取代人类的工作，我们相信，我们的基准测试有助于预测这种替代何时可能加速：通过追踪“智能体装瓶”在仅花费部分成本的情况下，其表现与前沿模型质量有多接近，它能让受影响的工人、雇主和政策制定者更早地获得预警，从而做好准备，例如通过再培训或支持计划。

paragraphs.en: We release the code of Bottled at https://github.com/aktsonthalia/bottled under the MIT License. The repository contains instructions and scripts to download and preprocess the three datasets, the agent environment (harness configuration, budget-tracking MCP tools and proxy rules), the task prompts, the evaluation code, and the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/aktsonthalia/bottled 上发布了 Bottled 的代码，并采用 MIT 许可证。该仓库包含下载和预处理三个数据集的说明与脚本、智能体环境（harness 配置、预算跟踪 MCP 工具和代理规则）、任务提示、评估代码以及基线模型。

paragraphs.en: We document the LLMs used in the current analysis in Table A1 . All models were invoked using OpenRouter; we intend to add more models in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 A1 中记录了当前分析所使用的 LLM。所有模型均通过 OpenRouter 调用；我们计划在未来添加更多模型。

paragraphs.en: We provide below the details on the distillation baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在下方提供了蒸馏基线的详细信息。

paragraphs.en: We use GLM 5.3 Flash for obtaining the labels. This process is identical to the one used for computing our zero-shot baseline ( Section 3.5.1 ), with the difference that we keep sampling instances for labeling randomly from the full workload, until the budget of 5 million tokens is exhausted. This process results in 12,765, 9,412, and 6,567 labels for MAVE, ESCI and RAID respectively. These labels are subsequently used for training the two students, and then evaluating each over the full workload. We hold out 10% of the teacher labels; in a single training run, the epoch with the best held-out loss is selected for evaluation. We conduct three independent runs (training followed by inference) for each student. Thinking is disabled for both students.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GLM 5.3 Flash 来获取标签。这一过程与我们计算零样本基线（第 3.5.1 节）时所用的过程完全相同，不同之处在于，我们会从完整的工作负载中随机持续采样实例进行标注，直到 500 万个 token 的预算用尽。该过程分别为 MAVE、ESCI 和 RAID 生成了 12,765、9,412 和 6,567 个标签。这些标签随后被用于训练两个学生模型，然后对每个模型在完整工作负载上进行评估。我们预留了 10% 的教师标签；在一次训练运行中，会选择预留集损失最小的那个训练轮次用于评估。我们对每个学生模型进行了三次独立的运行（先训练，后推理）。两个学生模型均未启用思考功能。

paragraphs.en: Following Fu et al. (2026) , we train Qwen3-0.6B for 3 epochs using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and a batch size of 64. The learning rate is warmed up over 10% of the steps and then follows a cosine decay schedule. During inference, we follow the settings recommended in the model card 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B for non-thinking mode (temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8, top- k k 20, min- p p 0.0).
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Fu et al. (2026) 的方法，我们使用 AdamW 优化器对 Qwen3-0.6B 进行 3 个周期的训练，学习率为 10^{-5}，批量大小为 64。学习率在步骤的 10% 内逐步提升，随后遵循余弦衰减策略。在推理阶段，我们遵循模型卡中为非思考模式推荐的设置：温度 0.7、top-p 0.8、top-k 20、min-p 0.0。

paragraphs.en: Following the alignment handbook 5 5 5 https://github.com/huggingface/alignment-handbook/blob/main/recipes/smollm2/sft/config_smol.yaml , we train SmolLM2-360M-Instruct with AdamW for 2 epochs with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and a batch size of 128. The learning rate is warmed up over 10% of the steps and then follows a cosine decay schedule. During inference, we follow the model card’s recommendation 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct at temperature 0.2 and top- p p 0.9.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循对齐手册 5 5 5 https://github.com/huggingface/alignment-handbook/blob/main/recipes/smollm2/sft/config_smol.yaml，我们使用 AdamW 对 SmolLM2-360M-Instruct 进行 2 个周期的训练，学习率为 10^{-3}，批量大小为 128。学习率在步骤的 10% 内逐步提升，随后遵循余弦衰减方案。在推理阶段，我们遵循模型卡的建议 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct，设置温度为 0.2，并采用 top-p 0.9。

paragraphs.en: All agents receive the same prompt for a given task and mode of execution (zero-shot/ bottled). Below, we specify each of these prompts. We note that a zero-shot prompt is followed by a single instance as a dictionary. We also note that the “Resources and Constraints” section is identical across all bottled runs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于给定的任务和执行模式（零样本/瓶装），所有智能体都会收到相同的提示。下面，我们将详细说明这些提示。请注意，零样本提示后跟一个字典形式的单个实例。此外，“资源与约束”部分在所有瓶装运行中均保持一致。

paragraphs.en: To ensure that Bottled tests agents’ capability to build a solution themselves (as opposed to retrieving a ready-made one from the web), we incorporate an extensive blocklist of patterns leading to URLs that expose the test dataset’s labels, or models trained on those labels (please see our public repository for the exact patterns). Since our blocklists may not necessarily be exhaustive, we further audited all 60 runs using an agentic judge. This judge (GLM 5.3 Flash in OpenCode) is given access to all the artifacts left by a bottling run (prompt, data, reasoning and tool calls) and is tasked with determining whether the agent was able to obtain the labels of the test dataset or a model trained on these labels.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保 Bottled 测试的智能体能够自行构建解决方案（而非从网络上获取现成的方案），我们引入了一份详尽的模式黑名单，这些模式会指向泄露测试数据集标签或基于这些标签训练的模型的相关 URL（具体模式请参见我们的公开仓库）。由于我们的黑名单可能并不完全全面，我们还使用了一个智能体裁判对所有 60 次运行进行了进一步审核。该裁判（OpenCode 中的 GLM 5.3 Flash）可以访问 Bottled 运行过程中留下的所有产物（提示、数据、推理过程及工具调用），其任务是判断智能体是否获取了测试数据集的标签或基于这些标签训练的模型。

paragraphs.en: We confirm that 59 out of 60 runs were judged as CLEAN ; none were flagged under NEEDS REVIEW and only one run (GLM 5.3 Flash on RAID) was found to be CONTAMINATED . In this run, the agent (knowingly) downloaded a detector trained partially on the RAID dataset. Quoting its final writeup at the end of the run, “Downloaded a ModernBERT detector trained on MAGE + RAID via the ModelScope mirror (HF was blocked) […]”. Despite obtaining this detector, the GLM 5.3 Flash bottling run was only able to obtain an AUROC of 0.857 (compared to one of Opus 5’s CLEAN bottling runs with an AUROC of 0.925), likely because the detector was not trained solely on RAID. Nevertheless, we conducted a rerun with an updated blocklist; our main results skip the contaminated run and incorporate the rerun in its place. We further confirm that all 21 runs in our ablation ( Section 4.3 ) were judged CLEAN .
paragraphs.zh: 我们确认，60 次运行中有 59 次被判定为“干净”（CLEAN）；没有任何一次被标记为“需要审查”（NEEDS REVIEW），且仅有一次运行（RAID 上的 GLM 5.3 Flash）被认定为“受污染”（CONTAMINATED）。在这次运行中，智能体（明知故犯地）下载了一个部分基于 RAID 数据集训练的检测器。引用该运行结束时其最终报告中的内容：“通过 ModelScope 镜像下载了基于 MAGE + RAID 训练的 ModernBERT 检测器（HF 被屏蔽了）[…]”。尽管获得了该检测器，GLM 5.3 Flash 的瓶化运行仅能取得 0.857 的 AUROC（相比之下，Opus 5 的一次“干净”瓶化运行的 AUROC 为 0.925），这可能是因为该检测器并非完全基于 RAID 训练的。尽管如此，我们还是使用更新后的屏蔽列表重新执行了该运行；我们的主要结果跳过了受污染的运行，并代之以重新执行的运行。我们进一步确认，我们消融研究（第 4.3 节）中的所有 21 次运行均被判定为“干净”。

paragraphs.en: We query Jev 1.13.0 through TypeSafe AI’s system_one endpoint, with one call per instance of the 1000-instance sample used for the zero-shot baseline. Within each call, we pass the instance as the state , together with a single question . A question comprises a type, natural-language instructions, and a set of criteria describing its possible answers. Costs are computed from Jev’s $0.042 per million input tokens, with output tokens unmetered.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 TypeSafe AI 的 system_one 端点向 Jev 1.13.0 发起查询，对于用于零样本基线的 1000 个实例样本中的每个实例，均发起一次调用。在每次调用中，我们将该实例作为状态传入，并附带一个单一问题。一个问题包含一个类型、自然语言说明以及描述其可能答案的一组标准。成本根据 Jev 每百万输入令牌 0.042 美元的费用计算，输出令牌不计费。

paragraphs.en: State is a dictionary with the shopper’s query and the product fields product_title , product_brand , product_color , product_description and product_bullet_point , of which some may be absent.
paragraphs.zh: 状态是一个字典，其中包含购物者的查询以及产品的字段：product_title、product_brand、product_color、product_description 和 product_bullet_point，这些字段中可能有些不存在。

paragraphs.en: Question type is choice : Jev picks exactly one of the criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 问题类型为选择：Jev 会精确地选择其中一个标准。

paragraphs.en: State is a dictionary with a single key text holding the document.
paragraphs.zh: 状态是一个字典，其中有一个键值对，键为 text，值为文档。

paragraphs.en: Question type is noul : Jev returns a probability that the true criterion holds; we treat it as Jev’s confidence that the document is AI-generated.
paragraphs.zh: 问题类型为 noul：Jev 返回一个表示真实标准是否成立的概率；我们将其视为 Jev 对该文档由人工智能生成的置信度。
